subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on July 15th, 2022. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 9:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before your flight. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Airline Team
